verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Nitrokey's hardware features (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV), its open-source firmware/CLI (nitropy), and community commentary on durability/support, but contains no mention of any telemetry, usage tracking, or opt-out settings for its software (nitropy CLI, firmware update service) or hardware. Since Nitrokey ships software tools that could in principle collect usage data, the axis applies, but there is no evidence either confirming or denying telemetry practices.
